name: Locthwain Castle
description: Queen Ayara's floating castle, which crashes to the ground and is transformed.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle hands over the ring but wishes the love potion to rain down, and a chasm opens as the pink rain falls on the horde.
timeline.quote: Instantly, the skies opened, and drops of pink rain began to fall.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Lovestruck by the rain, the Phyrexian legions chase Rankle and pour over the edge into the chasm.
timeline.quote: Wave after wave followed him, pouring over the edge like lovestruck lemmings.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A spell of many voices puts everyone in the chasm to sleep, and Rankle drifts down onto a throne of his fallen admirers.
timeline.quote: Rankle could see that everyone in the chasm had fallen into an unnatural sleep.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.
